sporedynamictrees.configuration.title: Spore Dynamic Trees Configuration
sporedynamictrees.configuration.minLifta: Spore mobs can only lift and throw Dynamic Trees branches at least this thick (8 is a full block). Liftable branches are thrown as their tree's log. Thinner branches, trunk shells, roots and rooty soil are never lifted.
sporedynamictrees.configuration.maxRotTr: The largest Dynamic Trees tree, in branch blocks, that Spore's infection can rot in one go. Larger trees are left untouched rather than half-rotted.
